title: Package vector
description: The package that a test vector of packages gives, package.yaml beside the module/ it is of (sections 9 and 25 of the format text): the module's server part, the listing of its device part, its inventory and its digest. An implementation builds the package of module/ and gets exactly these, whatever the order of keys. The results of a solver are the vector's, in the instances of the server part.

server_part.description: The server part: the canonical view of the module.

device_part.description: The listing of the device part.

digest.description: The digest of the package: the digest of the canonical text of its inventory.
